text.name: AI Compute Race
text.rules: Record "compute race". LIO spends 1 point on actions, then SAE spends 1 point on actions. Then draw from the Contingency deck of the side that played this card. If the result is 4 or more, LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: ChatGPT launched on 30 November 2022 and was estimated to have reached 100 million monthly users by January 2023; on 27 January 2025, after the Chinese company DeepSeek released a low-cost model, Nvidia's shares fell about 17 per cent, losing nearly $600 billion in value.
